title: How Starlink disruptions affected Ukraine's battlefield operations
summary: Starshield, the military version of SpaceX's Starlink satellite network that Ukraine relies on for communications, was partly restricted, disrupting Ukrainian operations. Liz Landers reports that Russian strikes on energy sites continued despite the announced ceasefire, while President Zelenskyy warned the cutback could cost lives and Elon Musk said limits on use are set by the US government. Retired Rear Admiral Mark Montgomery explains why the service is essential for mid-range strikes and argues the restrictions should be lifted.
focus: Shadow Mark Montgomery's answer on why Starshield matters for targeting and his view on what Washington is signalling: precise, briefing-style English with vivid metaphors.
